description: This Java class manages the state of an order list in a web-based application. It handles pagination, filtering, and order status/type filtering, maintaining state within user sessions. It provides methods to update state based on HTTP requests and retrieve filtered orders from the database.

classes.name: OrderListState
classes.description: Serializabled class that maintains the user's order list view state, including pagination and filtering criteria, and provides methods to fetch filtered orders based on current state.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's OrderListState instance from session or creates a new default instance.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the order list state based on parameters in the HTTP request, including pagination and filter/status toggles.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches a list of order headers from the database according to the current state filters and pagination parameters.
